flags.message: The grant-moment information set is not frozen at the April 6, 2026 grant. The 2026-08-16 snapshot contains post-grant docket entries, and brief-in-opposition.txt concatenates the March 6 cert response with a July 13 merits brief while documents.json marks the combined artifact truncated. The snapshot also duplicates the August 4 SET FOR ARGUMENT entry. I excluded all post-grant merits content from this forecast.
